regions.translation: QUESTA [this] herb is called by the Greeks Came meleon [chamaeleon]. There follows a heavily corrupted synonym list: patemion [?], dio scolofan [?], Crons, Losis, Chacin [?], aparzitos [?], Nifeos, hyer daitemes [?] and lene ptes [?]; the Italians call it bene oletes [?], supba Ulitica [?]; the [?] call it Thavotiz [?], Calio valizia [?], camparno [?], cinolatia, tili abriana [?], datia molusta [?].
